user.title: Pair Jibo locally
user.description: On Jibo, open Settings → Home Assistant → Start pairing. Enter the address and eight-digit code shown on his screen. Submit within two minutes; both devices finish automatically. No Phoenix password or Home Assistant access token is needed.

data.host: Jibo hostname or LAN IP address
data.legacy_device_id: Existing Jibo device to copy its room

reauth_confirm.title: Pair Jibo again
reauth_confirm.description: On this Jibo, open Settings → Home Assistant → Manage → Replace connection and confirm. Enter the newly displayed address and eight-digit code. Submit within two minutes; both devices finish automatically. The old connection is replaced only after successful physical-code verification.

data.host: Jibo hostname or LAN IP address
data.legacy_device_id: Existing Jibo device to copy its room

reconfigure.title: Change Jibo address
reconfigure.description: For an already paired Jibo, this changes only its address and verifies the stored certificate and local credential. It cannot trust a different robot or certificate. A legacy cloud connection instead requires physical local pairing; explicitly select the old Jibo device whose room should be copied, or choose not to copy a room.

data.host: Jibo hostname or LAN IP address
data.legacy_device_id: Existing Jibo device to copy its room

error.invalid_host: Enter a hostname or IP address and a valid local port, without a URL path, username, query or fragment.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach Jibo locally. Check its address, local network, direct Home Assistant mode and pairing window. No cloud fallback is used.
error.unsupported_tls: Jibo did not offer the required encrypted local connection. Check the direct integration firmware.
error.unsupported_protocol: Jibo uses an unsupported local protocol. Update the robot and this integration.
error.certificate_changed: The local certificate differs from the pinned pairing. No credential was sent to that peer. Verify the robot and start physical pairing again.
error.pairing_verification_failed: The physical code or authenticated exchange could not be verified. Check the code and address; start a fresh window if needed.
error.pairing_expired: The two-minute window expired. On Jibo, start pairing again and enter the new code.
error.pairing_rejected: Jibo rejected this pairing. Open a fresh window only if you want to try again.
error.pairing_unavailable: Open a fresh physical Home Assistant pairing window on Jibo. Another pairing may already be in progress.
error.invalid_claim: This pairing claim was rejected. Stop this flow and start a fresh physical pairing window.
error.pairing_failed: Jibo could not complete the pairing. Check its local screen before starting a new window.
error.rate_limited: Too many pairing attempts. Wait and open a fresh physical pairing window.
error.invalid_legacy_device: Choose one of this legacy installation’s Jibo devices, or explicitly choose not to copy a room.
error.invalid_auth: The stored local credential was rejected. Pair the same Jibo again through reauthentication.
error.wrong_robot: This address belongs to a different robot or pairing generation. The stored connection was not replaced.
error.invalid_pairing_code: Enter all eight digits shown on Jibo, including any leading zero. The code is valid only during the current physical pairing window.
error.pairing_upgrade_required: New pairing needs BE 13.3.0 or later. Update Jibo first. An existing verified local connection can stay paired.
error.pairing_busy: Another pairing attempt is in progress. Wait briefly and retry while Jibo’s code is still visible.
error.pairing_incomplete: Jibo did not confirm a complete pairing. Check his screen before starting a fresh pairing window.
error.pairing_confirmation_lost: The connection was lost before Home Assistant could confirm pairing. Jibo may already show Connected. Check his screen; start a fresh physical window to replace an incomplete connection.
error.local_storage_unavailable: Home Assistant could not save the local connection. Check available storage and the Home Assistant log before starting a fresh physical pairing window.

abort.already_configured: This locally identified Jibo is already configured.
abort.wrong_robot: This is a different Jibo. Add it as a separate integration entry instead.
abort.pairing_expired: Start a fresh physical pairing window on Jibo and a new setup flow.
abort.reauth_successful: Jibo has been paired again locally.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Jibo’s local address was verified and updated.

init.title: Jibo voice and local controls
init.description: Choose the conversation agent for home commands; the built-in Home Assistant agent is the default. Assign Jibo to an area for room context. Allow only the local robot controls you want; each is off by default. Camera permission allows explicit sessions of at most 60 seconds with a visible screen notice and a closed hatch. Quiet hours use Home Assistant’s time zone and block announcements, audio playback and audible skills. Add exact routine phrases for Assist-exposed scenes or scripts.

data.allow_audio: Allow speaker volume and local audio playback

error.invalid_shortcut: Choose a unique phrase of up to 80 characters and a scene or script. Ordinary Jibo commands are reserved. You can save up to 16 phrases; their combined size must fit one connector message.
error.shortcut_not_exposed: Expose this scene or script to Assist before adding a routine phrase.
error.invalid_quiet_hours: Choose valid start and end times for quiet hours.

unsupported_title.message: Jibo announcements accept a message without a title.

disconnected.message: Jibo’s local connection is disconnected. This announcement was not queued.

unsupported_announcements.message: This paired Jibo does not support direct announcements.

unsupported_robot_announcements.message: Direct Jibo announcements need BE 13.2.2 or later and the direct Home Assistant service mode.

permission_denied.message: Enable Allow announcements in this Jibo’s Phoenix integration options.

quiet_hours.message: Quiet hours are active. This announcement was not sent or queued.

robot_busy.message: Jibo is busy. This announcement was not queued.

confirmation_lost.message: Home Assistant could not confirm that Jibo finished speaking. The announcement will not be retried.

control_unavailable.message: Jibo control is unavailable: {reason}. No new action was sent.

control_confirmation_lost.message: Home Assistant could not confirm the result. Jibo may have acted. This action will not be retried automatically.

invalid_control_media.message: Choose local Home Assistant media: PNG/JPEG up to 1 MiB and 1280 × 720 pixels, or PCM16 WAV up to 8 MiB and 60 seconds. Web URLs and remote media are not supported.

control_media_upload_failed.message: The local media upload could not be confirmed. Playback or display was not requested.

control_camera_inactive.message: Start Camera explicitly with camera.turn_on. Camera permission, a closed hatch and an idle Jibo are required; each session lasts at most 60 seconds.

show_text.name: Show text on Jibo
show_text.description: Display plain text on this paired Jibo for a bounded duration.

show_image.name: Show an image on Jibo
show_image.description: Show a PNG or JPEG from Home Assistant’s configured local media directory.

media_content_id.name: Local media
media_content_id.description: A media-source://media_source/ identifier for an image up to 1 MiB and 1280 × 720 pixels.

clear_screen.name: Clear Jibo’s Home Assistant screen
clear_screen.description: Close only the screen opened by this integration; leave other robot activity alone.
